Rina Bose: hey team! Rina here  starting today on Customer Success. i'm mostly remote (oakland) but will be in SF occasionally. fun fact: i knit tiny hats for coffee cups and write very bad haikus. any tips for which bus to take from 16th st station to the office? also, is there a knitting circle or chill craft table? :yarn:
WelcomeBot: welcome to Redwood, Rina! :wave: Check the #new-hires guide for commute tips. You'll get an invite to the welcome lunch.
Hector: welcome Rina!! for buses, the 22 and 12 both stop near the office; 22 is usually faster at rush hour. we have a monthly "craft & coffee" on the last wednesday in the lounge  bring tiny hats. :coffee:
Becca S: hi Rina  there's a small craft box in the lounge with spare yarn and scissors. label any projects you want to keep. we'd love haikus for the kitchen corkboard. :pushpin:
Arlo: also FYI the SF office Slack thread posts commute updates and occasional ride shares. welcome aboard!
Rina Bose: amazing, thanks all!! i'll bring a stash of tiny cup hats and a haiku or two. see you at the craft night. :sparkles:
